typed_shape.TickSpec: locator: LocatorSpec|None; formatter: FormatterSpec|None; rotation: finite degrees|None. None leaves that native component unchanged; absent entire TickSpec preserves legacy defaults.
typed_shape.LocatorSpec: finite kind plus only named relevant fields; unknown or unused fields reject
typed_shape.FormatterSpec: finite kind plus only named relevant fields; no callbacks, eval, attribute format strings, arbitrary printf/strftime patterns or width
typed_shape.SecondaryAxisSpec: required transform: AxisTransformSpec; optional literal label; optional major_ticks/minor_ticks. No independent limits or arbitrary functions. x is top, y is right.
API: Plot.ticks(axis, spec, which='major', panel=0); spec=None clears that level
Plot.axis_scale(axis, scale, options=None, panel=0) atomically sets family and typed options
existing xscale/yscale remain, gain optional typed options without changing existing positional arguments
Plot.secondary_axis(axis, transform, ...) for named derived x/y; transform=None removes it
existing Plot.secondary_yaxis remains independent y2, unchanged
actions: SetAxisScale(axis, scale, options: ScaleOptionsSpec|None, panel=0) atomic new configuration

typed_shape.default_policy: All new fields default None and omit_none, appended only. Old schema/action JSON, categorical tick setup and old rendered pixels remain unchanged. Explicit new kinds use the stated native policies below, never implicit upstream-version kwargs.

locators.auto: scale/clock-aware native default; linear minor uses explicitly 4 subdivisions unless overridden
locators.fixed: strictly increasing finite nonbool coordinates, at most512, distinct and ordered AFTER float conversion (large-int collapse rejects), no data rewriting. Dates use canonical UTC1970 days, not input timestamp units
locators.multiple: positive finite step, finite offset(default0), linear numeric only; native MultipleLocator offset is supported at3.8
locators.max_n: nbins1..128(default8), integer bool(defaultfalse), prune none/lower/upper/both; native standard step policy, no arbitrary step callback
locators.auto_minor: linear numeric, subdivisions2..32(default4), uniformly spaced major ticks required
locators.log: positive numeric log coordinates; base inherited from axis, optional ordered positive subs below base, at most32. ScaleOptions.subs is MINOR policy for log/symlog/asinh; AUTO major retains native base powers/locations, minor inherits scale subs; explicit LocatorSpec.subs can override either rank
locators.symlog: native SymmetricalLogLocator using axis base/linthresh and finite optional subs
locators.asinh: native AsinhLocator using axis linear_width/base; count2..128(default11), optional finite subs
locators.calendar: TemporalSpec required; unit auto/year/month/week/day/hour/minute/second/microsecond, nonbool interval1..1000000(default1), weekday0..6 only for week(defaultMonday), auto target count2..128(default8 major/32 minor). Declared UTC/fixed-offset clock, calendar boundaries and existing epoch-shift adapter; no host timezone or global epoch mutation
locators.compatibility: Independent major/minor configuration. Date locators/formatters reject on non-temporal axes; numeric density/count axes are not calendarized. Ordinal axes preserve old defaults and accept only auto/none or explicit fixed positions/labels, not misleading numeric locator families.

formatters.fixed: literal label list paired with explicit fixed locator, identical lengths; each label<=128characters
formatters.scalar: native ScalarFormatter: scientific bool(defaulttrue), use_offset bool(defaulttrue), powerlimits two ordered ints within[-12,12](default[-5,6]), mathtext bool(defaultfalse), locale disabled
formatters.number: notation fixed/scientific/general(defaultgeneral), precision0..12(default3; general requires1..12 significant digits), optional literal prefix/suffix<=32characters each; no caller-supplied format string or width
formatters.percent: positive finite xmax(default1), decimals0..12(default1), native percent symbol
formatters.engineering: native EngFormatter unit literal<=32characters, places0..12 orNone(defaultNone), separator one of empty/space/thin-space/narrow-no-break-space; no version3.10-only EngFormatter offset option
formatters.log: style plain/exponent/mathtext/scientific, axis base inherited, label_only_base bool(defaultfalse)
formatters.logit: native probability formatter, half token fraction/decimal and use_overline bool(defaultfalse); no arbitrary TeX template
formatters.date: Finite ISO date/date-time/time/month/year/subsecond patterns use canonical EPOCH+timedelta+declared zone. Subsecond includes date and6digits. AUTO rebinds NEW calendar provider; fixed AUTO is full ISO date+6digits+offset, not stale-year or native distant-epoch20us rounding.
formatters.concise_date: Approved canonical datetime-vector adapter preserves Matplotlib3.8 finite level/zero/offset/trailingzero policy on calendar OR fixed temporal positions, TemporalSpec mandatory; no arbitrary format arrays. Copyright/license/change summary bundled in mudplot/_matplotlib_notice.txt; distribution expression MIT AND LicenseRef-Matplotlib, own LICENSE remains MIT.
formatters.limits: Finite format options only; formatter output<=512characters per tick. Existing trusted literal-text/TeX boundary is not redefined.

scales.log: base finite>1(default10), optional ordered finite subs below base; explicit base/subs work EVERYWHERE the existing log family is valid, including applicable statistical/native categorical/swarm paths. Existing positivity/missing/native-log10 geometry policies remain; no newly undefined request merely because parameters were supplied
scales.symlog: all finite real coordinates; base>1(default10), linthresh>0(default2), linscale>0(default1), optional finite subs; thresholds in coordinate units
scales.asinh: all finite real coordinates; linear_width>0(default1), integer tick-rounding base2..1024(default10), optional finite subs; width in coordinate units; native minimum3.8 API used
scales.logit: Strict finite open(0,1), native base10 transform. Approved native-scale/locator singular policy installed BEFORE first autoscale: constant p uses tail=min(p,1-p), open bounds0.1tail and1-0.1tail (native widening factor, complement symmetric, data contained); nonconstant native policy retained/containment checked. Unrepresentable native inverse/open view raises precision error, no epsilon/clipping. Explicit valid limits preserved; x/y/y2 covered.
scales.domain: Existing missing/native-gap policies remain: pure domain view inspects paired x/y (band x/y/y2) only, without filtering source/native paths or hiding native type parse errors. Finite actual geometry must meet domain. Scale installs before artists; final scale application precedes N12 locator installation and retains checked logit policy. Finite forward/inverse collapse/overflow rejects, no epsilon.
scales.finite_new_family_context: Only NEW symlog/asinh/logit families are restricted to Cartesian2D raw numeric line/scatter/bar/stem/stairs/errorbar/band/event/interval/reference/text/rug geometry, including applicable independent y2. Explicit log base/subs are NOT raw-only; existing log10 native-category spacing/inverse remains multiplicatively equivalent. New nonlinear categorical geometry rejects rather than falling through to linear spacing. Unsupported projection/family combinations reject.
scales.minimum_native_limits: Observed MPL3.8 collection get_datalim transforms raw bounds. Approved snapshot/restore of prior native DataLim/minpos/ignore then union ACTUAL new raw Rectangle bbox/Line2Dxy/segments/polygon vertices for bar/errorbar/stem/broken_barh ONLY when actual target has NEW scale. Native artists/source/gap/order/provider values unchanged; no fake collection offset origin, view/scale juggling or old log/linear change. secondary_transforms.affine: forward a*x+b, inverse(y-b)/a; required finite nonzero a, finite b(default0), explicit nonempty source_unit/target_unit; all-real monotonic, including negative slope
secondary_transforms.celsius_fahrenheit: 9*x/5+32 and5*(y-32)/9; declared degC todegF; all-real mathematical conversion, no inferred physical measurement validity
secondary_transforms.hertz_period: 1/x both directions, Hz tos, strictly positive visible domains; decreasing, no fabricated epsilon atzero
secondary_transforms.reciprocal: factor/x both directions, required positive finite factor and explicit source/target units; positive visible domains, decreasing
secondary_transforms.unix_seconds: 86400*canonical_day andseconds/86400; only explicitly temporal parent, UTC1970day toUnixseconds. Not the input column's unit/origin and independent of Matplotlib epoch
secondary_transforms.domain_and_visibility: Transform only derived VIEW coordinates, never raw-data domains; validate actual parent visible bounds, analytic invertibility/monotonicity and finite/precision-safe endpoints/ticks. Out-of-view zero observations remain valid for reciprocal with explicit positive view. No clamping, epsilon, arbitrary functions or inferred units. One explicit reverse flag may exchange analytic direction/declared units where meaningful, not an alias family explosion.
secondary_transforms.native_minimum_boundary: Use native secondary_xaxis/secondary_yaxis functions created only inside effects from this registry. Minimum3.8 SecondaryAxis special-cases only parent log versus function; support linear/log parents and the explicit linear temporal unix_seconds case. Reject symlog/asinh/logit-parent derived axes rather than misrepresent spacing. Log parents also require positive derived domain. Derived y cannot coexist with independent y2 on the same right spine.
